"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date."""
import datetime
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# --- 1. Create the cover page ---
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title, centered
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
title = "Annual Financial Report"
title_width = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawString((width - title_width) / 2, height / 2 + 40, title)

# Current date, centered below the title
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
date_width = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 16)
c.drawString((width - date_width) / 2, height / 2, date_str)

c.save()
print(f"Cover page written to {cover_path} (date: {date_str})")

# --- 2. Merge cover page with report.pdf ---
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)

print(f"Merged {len(reader.pages)} report page(s) after cover -> {output_path} "
      f"({len(writer.pages)} total pages)")

# --- 3. Verify: extract text from the first page of the output ---
check_reader = PdfReader(output_path)
first_page_text = check_reader.pages[0].extract_text()
print("--- Cover page text ---")
print(first_page_text)
assert "Annual Financial Report" in first_page_text, "Title missing from cover page!"
assert date_str in first_page_text, "Date missing from cover page!"
print("Verification passed: title and date present on cover page.")

    72:722,73:278,74:556,75:722,76:611,77:833,78:722,79:778,80:667,81:778,
    82:722,83:667,84:611,85:722,86:667,87:944,88:667,89:667,90:611,91:333,

    f"/F1 {FS_TITLE:g} Tf\n"
    f"1 0 0 1 {x_title:.2f} {y_title:.2f} Tm\n"
    f"({esc_pdf(title)}) Tj\n"
    f"/F2 {FS_DATE:g} Tf\n"
    f"1 0 0 1 {x_date:.2f} {y_date:.2f} Tm\n"
    f"({esc_pdf(date_str)}) Tj\n"
    f"ET\n"
).encode("latin-1")

cover_objects = {
    1: b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
    2: (f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R {new_pages_num} 0 R] "
        f"/Count {1 + report_page_count} >>").encode(),
    3: (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),
    4: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
    5: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
    6: b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + stream + b"endstream",
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assemble the merged PDF and rebuild the xref table
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
out = bytearray()
out += b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"
offsets = {}


def write_obj(num, body):
    offsets[num] = len(out)
    out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode() + body + b"\nendobj\n"


for num in sorted(cover_objects):
    write_obj(num, cover_objects[num])
for old in sorted(old_to_new):
    body = extract_object(report_data, entries[old])
    write_obj(old_to_new[old], renumber(body))

max_num = max(offsets)
xref_pos = len(out)
out += b"xref\n0 " + str(max_num + 1).encode() + b"\n"
out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for num in range(1, max_num + 1):
    if num in offsets:
        out += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    else:
        out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
out += (b"trailer\n<< /Size " + str(max_num + 1).encode() +
        b" /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n")

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    f.write(out)
print(f"Wrote {output_path} ({len(out)} bytes, {max_num} objects, "
      f"{1 + report_page_count} pages)")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Verify the merged PDF
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
with open(output_path, "rb") as f:
    merged = f.read()

# 1. xref offsets point at real object headers
check_entries = parse_xref(merged)
ok = True
for num, off in check_entries.items():
    if not merged[off:off + 20].startswith(f"{num} 0 obj".encode()):
        print(f"  FAIL: xref entry {num} offset {off} does not point at object header")
        ok = False
print("xref offset check:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")

def refs_in(body):
    """Find indirect refs, skipping any embedded stream data."""
    end = body.find(b"stream")
    scan = body if end == -1 else body[:end]
    return [(int(m.group(1))) for m in re.finditer(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", scan)]

all_ok = True
for num in sorted(offsets):
    body = merged[offsets[num]:]
    header_end = body.find(b"obj") + 3
    endobj_idx = body.find(b"endobj", header_end)
    obj_body = body[header_end:endobj_idx]
    for ref in refs_in(obj_body):
        if ref not in offsets:
            print(f"  FAIL: object {num} references missing object {ref}")

assert date_str in stream.decode("latin-1"), "date missing from cover stream"
print(f"cover stream check: PASS (title and date '{date_str}' present)")

    print(f"pypdfium2 render check: PASS ({len(pdf)} pages parsed, page 1 rendered)")
    page = pdf[0]

    bitmap.to_pil().save("cover_page_preview.png")
    print("  saved cover_page_preview.png")
except ImportError:
    print("pypdfium2 not available; skipped render check")

print("Done.")

def parse_xref(data):
    """Parse a classic xref table; return {objnum: offset}."""
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("startxref not found in report.pdf")
    xref_pos = int(m.group(1))
    section = data[xref_pos:].split(b"\n")
    entries = {}
    i = 1
    while i < len(section):
        line = section[i].strip()
        if not line:
            i += 1
            continue
        if line == b"trailer":
            break
        hm = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)", line)
        if hm:
            start, count = int(hm.group(1)), int(hm.group(2))
            i += 1
            for _ in range(count):
                if i < len(section):
                    em = re.match(rb"(\d{10})\s(\d{5})\s([nf])", section[i])
                    if em and em.group(3) == b"n":
                        entries[start] = int(em.group(1))
                    start += 1
                i += 1
        else:
            i += 1
    return entries


def extract_object(data, offset):
    """Return the raw body bytes of the object starting at offset."""
    header_end = data.find(b"obj", offset)
    if header_end == -1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"no 'obj' at offset {offset}")
    dict_start = header_end + 3
    stream_idx = data.find(b"stream", dict_start)
    endobj_idx = data.find(b"endobj", dict_start)
    if stream_idx != -1 and stream_idx < endobj_idx:
        endstream_idx = data.find(b"endstream", stream_idx)
        endobj_idx = data.find(b"endobj", endstream_idx)
    return data[dict_start:endobj_idx].strip()


def find_ref(body, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/" + key + rb"\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None
